files.shell.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}.shell{height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#18212d;background:#fff;font:14px system-ui}.toolbar{flex:none;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:8px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #ccd2dc}.panes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr) var(--inspector-width);flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}.pane{min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:16px}.navigation{border-right:1px solid #ccd2dc}.navigation h2{font-size:12px}.navigation button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent}.navigation [aria-current]{background:#e6edff;font-weight:700}.inspector{border-left:1px solid #ccd2dc}.resize{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px}.phone-controls{display:none}button,input{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,.pane:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2457c5;outline-offset:2px}.skip{position:fixed;top:8px;left:8px;transform:translateY(-200%);z-index:10;background:white;padding:8px}.skip:focus{transform:none}@media(max-width:760px){.phone-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}.phone-controls button{min-height:44px}.panes{display:block}.panes>.pane{display:none;height:100%}.panes[data-mobile-pane=navigation]>.navigation,.panes[data-mobile-pane=workspace]>.workspace,.panes[data-mobile-pane=inspector]>.inspector{display:block}.resize{display:none}.toolbar{flex-wrap:wrap}}
